# No storms this week for Punctual Pros

There are no storms in Punctual Pros' area this week. The National Weather Service shows zero active alerts in PA, NJ and the New England states. The forecast for the central Pennsylvania hubs is dry, mild and breezy, so this week's demand will come from normal October seasonality, not weather spikes.

## What the forecast shows

- There are no alerts in PA, NJ, MA, CT, RI, NH, ME or VT as of Oct 8, 2026 (National Weather Service alerts).
- Every hub shown has 0.0 inches of precipitation and a 0–1% chance of rain from Oct 6 through Oct 10 (Open-Meteo 7-day forecast).
- Oct 8 is the windiest day, with gusts of 25–30 mph. None of these winds triggered an alert.
- The forecast lists 10 hubs, but only 6 are visible here. The other 4 are unconfirmed.

## What drives demand instead

- **HVAC heating start-up.** October is the busiest HVAC month nationally because of heating start-up (Punctual Pros demand model, citing Samsara telematics). Overnight lows near 40°F could prompt first-use heating calls (est.).
- **Off-hours calls.** These fall in October. ServiceTitan data put the off-hours share at 9.8% in October 2025, versus 14.1% in June (Punctual Pros demand model). After-hours staffing can lean toward weekday daytime (est.).
- **Weather multipliers.** With no rain, alerts or extreme heat, the model's storm multipliers are likely inactive this week (est.). Expected calls fall back to baseline times the monthly index.
- **Market-wide baselines.** These are about 10 HVAC, 16 plumbing and 7 electrical calls per day per 10,000 households, across all providers (Punctual Pros demand model).

## What the data cannot answer yet

- A Punctual Pros call forecast for this week cannot be stated. It needs three inputs not shown here:
  - county household counts
  - the October monthly index
  - Punctual Pros market share, which the model flags as unknown
- The storm events history is a record of past events (Punctual Pros storm events). It gives no forward signal for this week.

## Next actions

- Pull Punctual Pros booked calls for Oct 6–12, 2026 from ServiceTitan, by trade and county. Compare them to the same week last year.
- Confirm the forecast and alert status for the 4 hubs not shown.
- Check that heating tune-up capacity and parts are staged for the October start-up peak.
- Load 12+ months of Punctual Pros call history so the model's assumed weather multipliers and market share can be replaced with fitted values.
